MIND. [1] [Chen. a.]
Weeping mood. θ Suppressed menses.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Chen. a.]
Vertigo with transient vanishing of sight. θ Hemicrania.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Chen. a.]
Pain in head and eyes ; neuralgia.
Pain in whole right side of head, with roaring in ears and dimness or complete loss of vision. θ Hemicrania.
Dull, pressive pain in vertex, extending through head.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Chen. a.]
Vanishing of sight. θ Hemicrania. θ Suppressed menses.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Chen. a.]
Roaring in ears ; deafness ; ringing in ears.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Chen. a.]
Subacute inflammation of tonsils.
Chronic enlargement of tonsils in pale, scrofulous children.
Caseous deposits, with painful inflammation of tonsils.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Chen. a.]
Slight pain in region of kidneys.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Chen. a.]
Menses suppressed ; has leucorrhœa instead.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Chen. a.]
Soreness in larynx, cannot sing. θ Suppressed menses.
A rough furry feeling in throat. θ Suppressed menses.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Chen. a.]
Difficulty of breathing. θ Suppressed menses.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Chen. a.]
Pains through breast, under right scapula, and in right shoulder.
Pain through right chest, beginning at the attachment of the sixth rib to its cartilage and extending to inferior angle of right scapula.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Chen. a.]
Pain beneath the point of the right shoulder blade, with sense of giddiness in forehead, ringing in ears and pale face.
Slight dull pain a little lower down than the inferior angle of the right scapula, but nearer the spine. θ Hemicrania. θ Asthma.
